protocol: HTTPS REST (OData v4) with Negotiate; Kerberos only since ConfigMgr 2509 (NTLM rejected)
credential_and_storage: Kerberos TGT/service ticket in the logon session (LSA; Credential Guard isolates it when on); SPN HTTP/<SMS Provider FQDN>
transport_and_key_exchange: TLS to port 443 with the site's self-signed certificate unless a PKI certificate is bound; Kerberos AES session key (RC4 off by default for service tickets from the 2026-04 updates)
minimal_permission: ConfigMgr security role + scope per operation (see permissions-matrix.csv); SMS Provider authentication level may also demand certificate or WHfB MFA
revocation_and_delay: AD disable or group removal: no new service tickets once the KDC refuses them; existing service ticket valid up to its lifetime (default 600 min); see revocation.md

identity: engineer (AD account; access through an AD group login)
transport_and_key_exchange: TLS per driver (ODBC Driver 18 / mssql-python encrypt defaults; see sqlserver/); Kerberos AES session key
minimal_permission: reader role SELECT; INSERT on dbo.operation with DENY UPDATE and DELETE
revocation_and_delay: group changes apply at the next connection; open connections keep their security context

protocol: OAuth 2.0 auth code + PKCE via MSAL Python public client (WAM broker on Windows)
credential_and_storage: no client secret; refresh token held by WAM or an MSAL cache persisted with msal-extensions (DPAPI on Windows)
transport_and_key_exchange: TLS to login.microsoftonline.com and graph.microsoft.com; optional Token Protection (Windows native clients); CAE with client capability cp1
revocation_and_delay: revokeSignInSessions kills refresh tokens in minutes; an issued access token lives to expiry (default 60-90 min; up to 28 h for CAE-capable sessions where the resource enforces CAE)

credential_and_storage: certificate credential (MSAL Python takes a readable PEM/PFX private key; a non-exportable CNG/TPM key needs a custom client_assertion signer) or no stored secret via Arc managed identity (core Arc features free; app roles assigned by Graph/PowerShell)
revocation_and_delay: remove the key credential / disable the service principal; issued app tokens live to expiry except that CAE for workload identities (Graph; single-tenant service principals; not managed identities) revokes on SP disable/delete or high risk

protocol: LDAP with SASL GSSAPI (Kerberos) or LDAPS
credential_and_storage: gMSA password managed by AD; retrieval limited by PrincipalsAllowedToRetrieveManagedPassword
transport_and_key_exchange: LDAP signing (or LDAPS/TLS) required when the DC enforces it; channel binding over TLS; ldap3 cannot sign/seal at the LDAP layer so LDAPS is the path for ldap3
minimal_permission: read of computer and group attributes (default domain read; not confirmed in an official page)
revocation_and_delay: gMSA disable: next ticket request refused

minimal_permission: read-only ConfigMgr role scoped to the collections synced
write on identity graph tables; single writer via sp_getapplock

credential_and_storage: gMSA Kerberos tickets; SPN cifs/<file server FQDN>
transport_and_key_exchange: SMB signing required by default on Windows 11 24H2 and Windows Server 2025; outbound encryption requirable by policy
minimal_permission: write for release (share and NTFS ACL); devices read
revocation_and_delay: existing SMB sessions keep their ticket until it expires or the session ends

target: Microsoft Graph (only if a CI job ever needs it)
protocol: Entra workload identity federation from GitLab id_tokens
credential_and_storage: no stored secret; ≤20 federated credentials per app; flexible (pattern) credentials in preview
transport_and_key_exchange: TLS; Entra fetches the issuer's OIDC keys so the GitLab issuer must be reachable by Entra
revocation_and_delay: delete the federated credential; issued token lives to expiry

minimal_permission: delegated scopes consented to the broker

protocol: OAuth 2.0 on-behalf-of to the CMG server app (user_impersonation) or Kerberos constrained delegation on-prem
credential_and_storage: broker credential; KCD needs delegation rights and fails for accounts marked sensitive or in Protected Users
minimal_permission: ConfigMgr role of the engineer (users must be discovered in ConfigMgr for CMG access)

protocol: MCP authorization 2026-07-28 (OAuth 2.1; protected resource metadata; resource indicators)
credential_and_storage: tokens held by the MCP client
revocation_and_delay: token lifetime of the authorization server

credential_and_storage: Azure Bot Service OAuth connection (Azure resource required)
